component.name: Penguchat
component.summary: WhatsApp Web as a native Linux desktop app

description.p: Penguchat is a small, unofficial desktop app for WhatsApp Web. It uses your system Qt, so it fits in with your desktop instead of shipping a whole Electron browser.

ul.li: Native desktop notifications with the sender's picture
Tray icon and task bar badge with the unread count
Close to tray and start at login
Links open in your default browser

description.p: Penguchat is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
